Flow 6: Undo Fix Resolved

Clipboard Undo Remediation

Transactional Revision Stack Prevents Data Loss
⚠️ Identified Data Loss Risk
The initial "Undo" button naively cleared the active clip without reverting preceding buffer state, risking permanent text deletion.
Naive Wipe
Before: Destructive
Ring Stack
After: 10-Item Rollback
🛡️ Solution Architecture
Integrated a 10-item transient undo ring buffer. Undoing rolls back pointer without dropping clipboard history.
